policy: the freeze file is written once and never edited; every later change is recorded here with the field, the reason and both values

amendments.when: after the freeze was written, before any v14 API request
amendments.reason: the read protocol's closing line (state the final diagnosis) was miscounted as a read call, so the task file declared eight model calls and the gate rebuilt seven reads. Corrected to six reads plus one answer = seven model calls, which is what the frozen worst-case arithmetic assumes (3 repeats x 4 tasks x 3 arms x 7 = 252 model calls, plus 36 summary calls, inside the frozen 300-request cap).
amendments.direction: correction to match the frozen protocol text and caps
fields_unchanged: views and their line ranges and file hashes
contract, answer pattern, required terms, literals
task ids, instances, base commits, repositories
amendments.effect_on_any_batch: none: no v14 batch existed when this was recorded, and the freeze's per-task blocks do not embed the corrected field
